question: Should maintainers keep this external PR as a landing candidate, or prefer the stricter replacement path once proof and conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The current branch has a real bug target but unresolved required-input fallback semantics and missing real setup proof, while the replacement PR is stronger but currently conflicting.

options.title: Keep Open For Contributor Proof

options.body: Proceed with the replacement PR only after its conflict/proof threshold is resolved, then close this source branch as superseded.

options.body: Maintainers may accept the keep/skip fallback, but that explicitly owns a credential setup behavior change.
